(Search snippet content — ABC News reporting, 24 July 2026)
A Friday-afternoon Russian ballistic missile attack on a Ukrainian defence-industry event in the Kyiv region killed at least ten and wounded over 100, per Zelensky; it was irregular for Russian ballistic strikes to take place in daytime hours, marking a shift in tactics. The strike came a day after Zelensky met in Kyiv with senior representatives of Raytheon, the US maker of the Patriot air-defence systems Ukraine needs. Ukraine welcomed a strike on a missile-components facility in the Russian city of Kirov.
